headline: Trump 🍊💣 threatens BOMBING Oman 🇴🇲 if they BLOCK his Iran deal
text:
Trump 🍊👴 went FULL RAGE MODE 😡💥 and threatened to BOMB 💣🧨 his own US ALLY Oman 🇴🇲 if they 'GET IN THE WAY' 🚧 of his Iran talks! Fox News 🦊📺 reported the BIG ORANGE 🍊 dropped the F-BOMB 💣🖕 during a phone interview while flexing his military muscles 💪🪖. 

The Strait of Hormuz 🌊⛽ is the BIGGEST OIL HIGHWAY 🛣️🛢️ in the world, moving 20% of global crude like it's the world's busiest Uber route 🚗💨! It's been CLOSED 🚫 for SIX MONTHS like a McDonald's drive-thru during a blizzard ❄️🍔 because of the US-Iran beef 🥩💥. 

Oman 🇴🇲 has been playing Switzerland 🧀🇨🇭 by talking to Iran 🇮🇷 about reopening the waterway, but Trump says they're gonna get the SMACKDOWN 💥👊 if they mess with his IRAN DEAL 🤝💼. Earlier that day, Iran said they were THIS CLOSE 🤏 to finalizing their own deal with Oman, making Trump look like he was getting PLAYED like a fiddle 🎻😤. 

The 60-DAY MoU ⏰📋 between US and Iran is EXPIRING 💀 like milk left in the sun 🥛☀️, and when BBC asked if Trump wanted an extension, he hit them with a HARD NO 🙅‍♂️. Meanwhile, he's bragging about having a SECRET BACKCHANNEL 📞🔒 with Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps 🪖🇮🇷, but they called it DELUSIONAL NIGHTMARES 🌙😵 caused by 'DEFEAT AND DESPERATION' 😭💦. 

Iran wants 5-7% transit FEES 💰💸 on every oil cargo like they're running a TOLL BOOTH 🛣️💳 on the world's most important shipping lane! Trump said the Iranians are 'GOOD POKER PLAYERS 🃏🎰 but they're DYING' 💀, claiming he's in NO HURRY ⏳ to end the war while the whole region burns like a bad Tinder date 🔥📱. 

The ceasefire went up in SMOKE 💨 after just weeks, with Trump calling Iranian leadership 'SCUM' 🦠 and 'CUCKOO' 🐦. Now he's posting on Truth Social 📱🐦 that Iran CANNOT have nukes ☢️🚫, but with the MoU DEAD 💀 and everyone threatening everyone else, it looks like we're back to playing geopolitical CHICKEN 🐔🚗 on the world's most dangerous highway!
